1. Keep the QR code visible on your computer, in the terminal or browser window opened by the command.
2. Open MAX on your phone and select the account you want to connect.
3. Go to **Settings → Devices** and open its QR login scanner. Labels can vary by app version.
4. Scan the computer’s QR code using the scanner inside MAX and confirm the connection if asked.
5. If MAX asks for an additional account password, enter it at the terminal prompt; input is hidden.
6. Wait for the command to finish successfully, then run `max personal account show` to verify the account and `max personal chats list --limit 5` to read a few chats.

[Official MAX login instructions](https://help.max.ru/help/account/dostup_k_prophilyu/kak_voiti_v_prophil_max_esli_on_uzhe_est).

The token's lifetime is unknown: MAX does not report it. It continues working after the web.max.ru tab is closed. When MAX stops accepting it, log in again with `max personal session start`.

en.after:
MAX does not report a fixed token expiration time, so the CLI cannot promise a number of days. Closing the web.max.ru tab does not end the authorization. If MAX rejects the saved token, reconnect by QR:

```sh
max personal session start qr
```

For a work profile, use `max work session start qr`. Then run `max personal account show` (or `max work account show`) to verify the account. The bare `max personal session start` command imports an existing token rather than displaying a QR code. `max personal doctor` shows the login count for the profile.

## Tools

**Command coverage.** These tools give the agent access to most everyday command-line operations: messages, chats, contacts, attachments, conversation analysis and statistics. The search tool returns available commands with their argument schemas and effects; availability follows provider support and profile permissions. Use the [complete command reference](./commands.md) for syntax and parameters. en.before: With `--file`, `.jpg .jpeg .png .webp .gif` are sent as photos, `.mp4 .mov .webm .mkv` as videos, and everything else as files. With `--as-file`, the `--file` attachment is sent as a file, including videos. `--photo` accepts only `.jpg .png .webp`. A message can contain one `--file` attachment and one `--photo` attachment; **videos and files must be sent alone**, and the command rejects invalid combinations before uploading. Text is optional. If upload fails, nothing is sent. `max` does not currently send multiple files in one message. `--no-preview` is unavailable in MAX: its own client cannot do this, and the command rejects it.
en.after: With `--file`, `.jpg .jpeg .png .webp .gif` are sent as photos, `.mp4 .mov .webm .mkv` as videos, and everything else as files. With `--as-file`, videos from `--file` are sent as downloadable files; images are still sent as photos. `--photo` accepts only `.jpg .png .webp`. A message can contain one `--file` attachment and one `--photo` attachment; **videos and files must be sent alone**, and the command rejects invalid combinations before uploading. Text is optional. If upload fails, nothing is sent. `max` does not currently send multiple files in one message. `--no-preview` is unavailable in MAX: its own client cannot do this, and the command rejects it.

messages. While `serve` or `watch` runs, a star you set or take off on the phone reaches the store too, and
`watch --events` prints it; so do the stars of the messages the phone pushes right after linking. Whether the phone
shows a star set with `wa` has not been checked yet.

en.after:
`10.0.0.%` stands for the address of the computer that runs `pbx`. When the database is on another computer, it must
also accept that address:

1. On MySQL or MariaDB, set `bind-address` in the server's settings to an address your computer reaches, not
   `127.0.0.1`, and restart the database. On PostgreSQL, add that address to `listen_addresses` in `postgresql.conf`,
   and a line for the user to `pg_hba.conf`, such as `host asteriskcdrdb wirecat_reader 10.0.0.0/24 scram-sha-256`.
2. Let your computer's address through the firewall to the database port, and no other address.
3. Turn on `db_tls true` when the connection crosses a network you do not control.

Not ready to open the database to the network? Reach it
[through the phone system's SSH](#a-database-behind-the-phone-systems-ssh) instead.

`cdr_source postgres` reads PostgreSQL.

en.before: `db_ssh_port` changes the SSH port (22).
en.after:
The SSH user needs no shell. Make one before the first `session start`, on the phone system, as root:

1. Create the user with no shell, and give it your public key:

   ```sh
   useradd --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin wirecat
   install -d -m 700 -o wirecat -g wirecat /home/wirecat/.ssh
   install -m 600 -o wirecat -g wirecat wirecat_pbx.pub /home/wirecat/.ssh/authorized_keys
   ```

2. Let it forward only to the database. Add this to the end of `/etc/ssh/sshd_config`, with the `db_host` and
   `db_port` you set (`127.0.0.1:5432` for PostgreSQL):

   ```text
   Match User wirecat
       AllowTcpForwarding local
       PermitOpen 127.0.0.1:3306
       PermitTTY no
       X11Forwarding no
       AllowAgentForwarding no
   ```

3. Check the file with `sshd -t`, then reload the SSH server with `systemctl reload sshd`.

`pbx` asks the SSH server only to forward to the database, so this user can do nothing else on the phone system.

`db_ssh_port` changes the SSH port (22).

1. В MySQL или MariaDB задайте в настройках сервера `bind-address`: адрес, до которого доходит ваш компьютер, а не

es.before: `cdr_source postgres` lee PostgreSQL.
es.after:
`10.0.0.%` es la dirección del ordenador donde funciona `pbx`. Si la base de datos está en otro ordenador, también
debe aceptar esa dirección:

1. En MySQL o MariaDB, pon en los ajustes del servidor `bind-address`: una dirección a la que llega tu ordenador, no
   `127.0.0.1`. Después reinicia la base de datos. En PostgreSQL, añade esa dirección a `listen_addresses` en
   `postgresql.conf`, y una línea para el usuario en `pg_hba.conf`, como `host asteriskcdrdb wirecat_reader 10.0.0.0/24 scram-sha-256`.
2. Deja pasar por el cortafuegos hasta el puerto de la base de datos la dirección de tu ordenador y ninguna otra.
3. Activa `db_tls true` cuando la conexión cruce una red que no controlas.

¿Prefieres no abrir la base de datos a la red? Llega a ella
[por el SSH de la propia centralita](#a-database-behind-the-phone-systems-ssh).

`cdr_source postgres` lee PostgreSQL.

es.before: `db_ssh_port` cambia el puerto SSH (22).
es.after:
El usuario SSH no necesita un intérprete de comandos. Créalo antes del primer `session start`, en la centralita,
como root:

1. Crea el usuario sin intérprete y dale tu clave pública:

   ```sh
   useradd --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin wirecat
   install -d -m 700 -o wirecat -g wirecat /home/wirecat/.ssh
   install -m 600 -o wirecat -g wirecat wirecat_pbx.pub /home/wirecat/.ssh/authorized_keys
   ```

2. Déjale reenviar solo hasta la base de datos. Añade esto al final de `/etc/ssh/sshd_config`, con el `db_host` y el
   `db_port` que pusiste (`127.0.0.1:5432` para PostgreSQL):

   ```text
   Match User wirecat
       AllowTcpForwarding local
       PermitOpen 127.0.0.1:3306
       PermitTTY no
       X11Forwarding no
       AllowAgentForwarding no
   ```

3. Comprueba el archivo con `sshd -t` y recarga el servidor SSH con `systemctl reload sshd`.

`pbx` solo pide al servidor SSH que reenvíe hasta la base de datos, así que este usuario no puede hacer nada más en la
centralita.

`db_ssh_port` cambia el puerto SSH (22).
